title: Surreal Eye of Creation
description: A large stylized eye dominates the center of a surreal landscape, its iris containing a green field with symbols including an ouroboros, moon phases, sun, and flowers. A purple patterned snake coils from the left, a red mouse sits on a branch to the right, while a robed figure holding a lantern walks along a path through a vibrant flower garden below; lightning strikes from a stormy sky above.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting featuring a giant stylized eye embedded in a hilly landscape. Inside the green iris are an ouroboros, crescent moons, sun, and flowers. A large purple patterned snake coils from the left side with its tongue out. A small red mouse sits on a branch with flowers on the right. A woman in a patterned robe walks away holding a glowing lantern along a path through a colorful flower garden with glowing lanterns. Dramatic stormy sky with purple clouds and bright yellow lightning bolts striking the scene.
